# Photos

Photos behind the home screen styles. Each is cropped to 16:9 and colour graded for the home
screen; the glow masks next to them are drawn from the same photo.

| File | Photo | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/home_style_nature.webp`, `home_style_nature_glow.webp` | Moraine Lake at sunrise, Banff National Park. [Pexels photo 417074](https://www.pexels.com/photo/417074/) | [Pexels License](https://www.pexels.com/license/): free to use and modify, no attribution required |
| `app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/home_style_dusk.webp`, `home_style_dusk_glow.webp` | A path under burning evening clouds, a painting by **Angel Ganev** (his signature stays on the picture). | Used with the artist's permission. Not covered by the app's licence; do not reuse it without asking him. |

The stills in `app/src/main/res/raw/home_still_*.mp4`, which the TV's video chip shows, are the
same pictures; the photo styles are rebuilt at 4K from the original photos above, with the same
crop and grade.

## Videos

- Deep Blue (`res/raw/home_style_deepblue.mp4`, poster `home_style_deepblue.webp`): animation made by Adrian, the app's owner, cropped, shaded where the clock and tiles sit and re-encoded for the home screen at its full 60 frames a second.
- Ice Lake (`res/raw/home_style_icelake.mp4`, poster `home_style_icelake.webp`): a frozen lake at sundown filmed from Adrian's own drone, scaled to 1080p, shaded where the clock and tiles sit and played forwards then backwards so the 12 second flight loops without a cut, at 60 frames a second.
